about: Laurus Labs Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells medicines and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally. The company offers Generics APIs and solid oral drug products for intermediates for anti-retroviral (ARV), anti-diabetic, cardiovascular, anti-asthma, ophthalmology, oncology, and gastroenterology.
